user.title: Connect Gmail
user.description:
Package Tracker reads shipping and order e-mails locally in Home Assistant. It only requests read-only Gmail access.

Create an OAuth client of type **Web application** in the Google Cloud Console, enable the Gmail API and register this redirect URI:

`{redirect_uri}`

Then paste the client ID and client secret here.
